annotations.title: 13F fund holdings (what a hedge fund or investor owns)

description: Answers "What does Warren Buffett own?", "What did Michael Burry buy last quarter?", "Did Bridgewater sell Nvidia?" or "What are Cathie Wood's biggest positions?". Give a fund or investor name (Berkshire Hathaway, Bridgewater, Renaissance, Pershing Square/Ackman, Scion/Burry, ARK/Cathie Wood, Citadel, Soros, Tiger Global, Appaloosa/Tepper, Icahn, Baupost, Third Point, Duquesne/Druckenmiller, Vanguard, Two Sigma, Elliott, Viking, D. E. Shaw and any other 13F filer) or its SEC CIK. Returns the latest (or any `period`) 13F-HR: total value, number of positions, each position (issuer, CUSIP, value, shares, % of portfolio, options marked put/call) merged across sub-managers, and against the quarter before: new positions, positions sold out, the biggest adds and cuts, and a plain-English `summary`. Managers with over $100M in US equities file within 45 days of each quarter's end. Unknown funds are not charged. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

cik.description: The manager's SEC CIK, e.g. 1067983 (Berkshire Hathaway).

fund.description: The investment manager or investor, e.g. "Berkshire Hathaway", "Bridgewater", "Cathie Wood" or "Michael Burry". Use this or `cik`.

limit.description: How many positions to list, largest first (1-200, default 25). Totals and changes always cover the whole portfolio.

period.description: Which quarter: "latest" (default), a quarter-end date such as 2026-06-30, or 2026-Q2.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
